brain.commentary: Broad cross-asset stress, elevated expected shortfall, and only marginal long composites warrant materially reduced risk. BTC is the most defensible signal but remains vulnerable to regime-wide de-risking. ETH and SOL are fragile due to higher beta, volatility, and weak or negative alpha. BCH, DOGE, and LTC are fragile flat signals with negative composites and weak institutional/liquidity support. ETC is invalid for sizing: zero price, volatility, liquidity, and expected-shortfall inputs make its long signal especially unreliable.
